<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="chest_with_lid">

  <!-- Base of the chest -->
  <link name="base">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.265" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.55 0.23 0.53"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="brown">
        <color rgba="0.55 0.27 0.07 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.265" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.55 0.23 0.53"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <mass value="20.0"/>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.265" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.5563" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.9723" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.5923"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- Lid of the chest -->
  <link name="lid">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.115 0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.55 0.23 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="dark_brown">
        <color rgba="0.4 0.2 0.05 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.115 0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.55 0.23 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <mass value="5.0"/>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.115 0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.0222" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.1262" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.1481"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- Hinge joint for the lid (rotates about X axis) -->
  <joint name="lid_hinge" type="revolute">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="lid"/>
    <!-- Origin at the back top edge of the chest -->
    <origin xyz="0 0.115 0.53" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit effort="10.0" velocity="1.0" lower="0.0" upper="1.5708"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.1" friction="0.2"/>
  </joint>

</robot>
